home.title: FT_TRANSCENDENCE
home.description: [FT_TRANSCENDENCE] is a multiplayer minigames platform where users can compete against each other in real time. This project is part of the 42 curriculum and demonstrates full-stack web development.
common.termsWarning: 🛈 Before signing in, you should read our
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.section1.title: 1. Information we collect
legal.privacy.section1.text: We collect basic information needed for the proper operation of the platform, such as your username, email address, and in-game profile data.
legal.privacy.section2.title: 2. Use of information
legal.privacy.section2.text: We use the information collected to manage user sessions, keep score records, and maintain in-game statistics.
legal.privacy.section3.title: 3. Data protection
legal.privacy.section3.text: Your credentials are stored securely and encrypted using modern algorithms. We do not share your data with third parties.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.section1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
legal.terms.section1.text: By accessing and using this application, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions of service.
legal.terms.section2.title: 2. User conduct
legal.terms.section2.text: Abusive behavior, cheating in games, or malicious use of system features is prohibited.
legal.terms.section3.title: 3. Accounts and points
legal.terms.section3.text: The points or coins assigned within the application are virtual and have no real monetary value. The system reserves the right to modify or reset scores in case of failures or unsportsmanlike conduct.
